bonds.title: My Bonds
bonds.subtitle: Your Bangladesh prize bonds. Check them against any result PDF in Draw Check.
bonds.empty: No bonds yet. Add bonds or import your Excel file.

form.pasteHint: One per line or separated by comma / space. Bangla digits are fine; missing leading zeros are added.
form.seriesHint: Optional. A winning number wins in every series.
form.commonHint: These details apply to every bond added now.

import.title: Import from Excel / CSV
import.hint: Download the sample format, fill it in and upload it. Only the Bond Number column is required. Files without a header row also work: bond numbers are detected automatically.
import.noHeader: No header row: bond numbers were detected automatically.
import.rowValuesHint: Used only for rows where the file has no holder / purchase date.
import.tplHelp1: 1. Keep the first row (column names) as it is.
import.tplHelp2: 2. One bond per row. Bond Number is required: 7 digits, keep leading zeros (e.g. 0063559).
import.tplHelp3: 3. Series is optional: two Bangla letters, e.g. কখ. A winning number wins in every series.
import.tplHelp4: 4. Purchase Date is optional (YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY). It is used for the 60-day draw rule.
import.tplHelp5: 5. Delete the two sample rows before uploading. Only the first sheet is read.
